# YouTube agent skills for DSH

Seven skills for drafting scripts, content plans, comment replies, and YouTube metadata.

Automatic selection is off by default and controlled for the current Agent with `/dsh-youtube-agent-skill-tonulls on` and `/dsh-youtube-agent-skill-tonulls off`. Direct invocation remains available. The source license and notices are included in the package.
